description: Lines on the meeting panel for a resident in the room, from the meeting's own record (the body, its date and its agenda). The panel picks among a part's wordings (`<key>.w2`, `<key>.w3`) with screenPick.

slots.body: The body's recorded office title (its council or board), from the meeting's record.
slots.date: The meeting's date, as people say it ("March 4").
slots.count: How many items are on the meeting's agenda, as a word ("three"), from the agenda.
slots.item: The one open item's title as the panel shows it ("Budget Ordinance"), from the bill's title record; unsaid when the bill has none.
